title: The Effects of the Swiss Ball on Cerebral Vascular Accident
brief_summary: The objective of this study was to investigate the effects of the Swiss ball on patients with hemiplegia due to CVA.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Hemiplegia due to CVA
* In physiotherapy treatment
* Acceptance in join the research

Exclusion Criteria:

* Less then 6 months of diagnostic
